summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting a routine share repurchase. On May 7, 2026, the company repurchased 331,208 of its own shares at an average price of USD 8.8938 per share, representing 0.0184% of existing issued shares. The repurchased shares were held as treasury shares, not cancelled. There is no change in total issued shares. This is an ordinary share buyback activity, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural details are provided. What to watch: ongoing buyback program execution.
